units.source_text: 源氏公子对胧月夜原是另眼看待的，听见她要去当朱雀帝的后宫，心中不免可惜。

en.t: Prince Genji had always regarded Oborozukiyo with special feeling, and when he heard that she was to enter Emperor Suzaku's court as a consort, he could not help feeling regret.

units.source_text: 但目下他的爱情集中于紫姬一身，无暇分向别人。

en.t: But for the moment his love was centered entirely on Lady Murasaki, and he had no attention to spare for anyone else.

units.source_text: 他想：“人生实短，不须东钻西营，我就死心塌地地专爱这一个人吧。

en.t: He thought, "Life is truly short; there is no need to chase after affection here and there. I should simply devote myself wholeheartedly to loving this one person alone.

units.source_text: 何必拈花惹草，徒然买人怨恨呢？”

en.t: Why should I trifle with other women and needlessly earn people's resentment?"

units.source_text: 他回想过去种种苦厄，深自警戒。

en.t: He thought back on all the hardships he had suffered in the past and sternly warned himself against repeating them.

units.source_text: 他又想起那个六条妃子：“这个人也很可怜。

en.t: He also remembered the Rokujo lady and thought, "She too is very pitiable.

units.source_text: 然而正式娶她为夫人，又有种种不便。

en.t: Yet formally taking her as my wife would bring all sorts of difficulties.

units.source_text: 还不如像近年来那样不即不离。

en.t: It would be better to keep the same neither too close nor too distant relationship we have had in recent years.

units.source_text: 那么每逢兴会，可以和她纵谈风月，添助雅兴，岂不甚好？”

en.t: Then, whenever the mood arose, I could speak freely with her of poetry, beauty, and the seasons, adding to the elegance of the occasion. Would that not be very fine?"

units.source_text: 过去虽然为了生魂之事，略有嫌隙，但对她并不断念。

en.t: Although there had been some estrangement in the past over the matter of the living spirit, he had by no means given up his thoughts of her.
